notes: Seed URL www.co.polk.tx.us failed (https: certificate not valid for that host; http: HTTP 403). One web search located the current site www.polktx.gov (CivicPlus). No Clarity site (elections.json 404). The Elections page lists 'Cumulative Results-3-3-2026' and 'Precinct Results-3-3-2026', and 'Cumulative Results- 5-26-2026' and 'Precinct Results-5-26-2026'. Both precinct files are 'Precinct Results Report ... Unofficial Results' with per-precinct rows and Election Day votes, 'Precincts Reporting 22 of 22 = 100.00%': primary Run Time 9:53 PM Run Date 03/03/2026 (CreationDate Mar 4 03:53 UTC), runoff Run Time 9:28 PM Run Date 05/26/2026 (CreationDate May 27 02:28 UTC; file name 'Precinct-Results-5-26-2026-09-28-21-PM'). So precinct numbers with election-day votes were printed on election night, but the server stamps every response (PDFs included) with the request time as Last-Modified (e.g. Fri, 02 Oct 2026 15:44:54 GMT), so there is no evidence of when they were posted online; END versus LATER cannot be decided by check 2. The 'Election Results Portal' (polkcountyapps.net/easydocs/election/) returned HTTP 403. The 2024 general is not listed on the current Elections or Election Results pages. Check 3 pending: origin/wayback-data not present. Targeted pass 3 2026-10-02 (targeted3-A): 2026_primary and 2026_runoff changed UNDETERMINED -> END (check 2). The earlier pass left them open because the upload time is unknown; TARGETED3_BRIEF item 2 and rule 47 say that when the server stamps every file with the request time there is no upload time and the printed run time decides. Re-verified: Last-Modified on DocumentCenter/View/1104, 1105 and 1298 equals the fetch time to the second (15:44:54, 15:44:58, 15:45:00 GMT on 2026-10-02). Note: CHECKLIST_BRIEF's confidence text asks for both printed and upload times for med; compute_confidence (DECISIONS 40) returns med for two check 2 elections and was applied as instructed. 2024 general: the Election Returns portal at https://polkcountyapps.net/easydocs/election/ now loads but lists years only to 2022; Elections page lists no 2024 results; Wayback main harvest targeted co.polk.tx.us with no captures; no phase1/targeted/ folder for Polk; sweep pending. Orchestrator 2026-10-02: 2024_general set to LATER from verifier-9's finding (county page links the Nov 2024 unofficial county-totals report, printed 9:40 PM; no precinct report posted). Tag unchanged (two END elections).
tag_rationale: The 2026 primary and 2026 runoff are both END (check 2: unofficial precinct reports printed 9:53 PM and 9:28 PM on election night, with no upload time because the server stamps the request time), so the tag is PRECINCT_END_OF_NIGHT; confidence med is computed by compute_confidence (two check 2 elections). The 2024 general remains UNDETERMINED.

2024_general.fact: Corrected from verifier-9 (DECISIONS 64; the earlier fact, 'not listed', was wrong): Polk's Election Results page (polktx.gov/389/Election-Results) lists for the November 2024 election only 'Unofficial Results (PDF)' (DocumentCenter/View/301): 'Cumulative Results Report POLK COUNTY, TEXAS Unofficial Results GENERAL ELECTION', 'Precincts Reporting 42 of 42 = 100.00%', 'Run Time 9:40 PM', 'Run Date 11/05/2024', CreationDate Wed Nov 6 03:41:07 2024 UTC (9:41 PM CST). County totals only, by vote type. No precinct report for Nov 2024 is posted, while the same page posts both 'Cumulative Results' and 'Precinct Results' for March 5, 2024, and the Elections page posts both for March and May 2026. The older Election Results Portal (polkcountyapps.net/easydocs/election/) lists years only through 2022 (2024 and 2026 year pages return HTTP 500). The server (CivicPlus DocumentCenter) stamps Last-Modified with the request time, so there is no upload time; the printed run time is used. Precinct numbers with election-day votes were never published online for this election as far as the county's pages show. Earlier research fact: Not listed on the current Elections or Election Results pages; the Election Results Portal returned HTTP 403. Check 3 pending.

2026_primary.fact: 'Precinct Results-3-3-2026' on the county Elections page (www.polktx.gov/313/Elections) is a 'Precinct Results Report ... Unofficial Results POLK COUNTY, TEXAS ... PRIMARY ELECTION ... Precincts Reporting 22 of 22 = 100.00% Run Time 9:53 PM ... Run Date 03/03/2026' (PDF CreationDate Wed Mar 4 03:53:24 2026 UTC) with per-precinct rows that include election-day votes, e.g. precinct '1' 'Jasmine Crockett 0 0.00% 4 57.14% 3 60.00% 7 58.33%' under 'Absentee Voting Early Voting Election Day Voting Total'. No upload time is available: the CivicPlus server returns Last-Modified equal to the request time (Fri, 02 Oct 2026 15:44:54 GMT, the moment of the fetch). Under rule 47 the printed run time (9:53 PM on election night, final unofficial count, 22 of 22 precincts) decides: END. It is the only precinct report listed for this election.

No upload time is available (Last-Modified equals the request time, Fri, 02 Oct 2026 15:44:58 GMT). Under rule 47 the printed run time (9:28 PM on election night, final unofficial count) decides: END. It is the only precinct report listed for this election.
